reads.name: status
reads.description: Connection, selected probe, jobs, outposts and the request lane.

reads.name: state
reads.description: One snapshot of everything: fleet, the selected (or named) probe with crew and inventory, its sector with contacts and missiles, jobs, outposts and unread alerts.

reads.name: probes
reads.description: Every probe you own, with position, movement, fuel and integrity.

reads.name: probe
reads.description: One probe in detail, with its crew and inventory.

reads.name: sector
reads.description: What the probe's sensors see: bodies, mineable targets, relays, refuel station, other ships (contacts) and missiles in flight.

reads.name: crew
reads.description: The probe's Mannies and their tasks.

reads.name: alerts
reads.description: The game's alerts for the probe.

reads.name: archive
reads.description: Every sector GUPPI has observed (the star map's data) and the saved bookmarks.

reads.name: jobs
reads.description: Running and recent automations (voyages, mining runs, craft queues, scans, outposts).

reads.name: job
reads.description: One job with its full log.

reads.name: events
reads.description: What happened since an event number: job changes, arrivals, new alerts, inbound missiles. Ask with Accept: text/event-stream for a live stream.

reads.name: openapi
reads.description: This API as an OpenAPI 3.1 document.

actions.name: select-probe
actions.description: Take command of a probe in GUPPI (changes what the desktop shows; agents can address any probe by id without this).

actions.name: jump
actions.description: Fly a probe to a sector. Within the 'sectors per jump' limit a single jump is sent; anything further becomes a voyage of several jumps (a job). mode 'voyage' always makes a managed voyage, with optional scanning on arrival and a deuterium reserve.

target.description: Sector relative to home; x + y + z must be even.

reserve.description: Voyage refuses to jump below this deuterium percentage.

actions.name: scan
actions.description: Observe the 12 neighbouring sectors of the probe's position into the archive (a job).

actions.name: mine
actions.description: Start a mining run: the amount is split into 0.05 ECE loads across the chosen Mannies (default: every Manny ready aboard). Deuterium goes to the tank; solids to the probe or to a detached container.

objectId.description: A mineable body id from the sector reading.

resources.description: Default: every resource the body offers.

containerId.description: Detached container to deliver into (required for a Manny stationed in another sector).

actions.name: craft
actions.description: Queue crafts of a recipe (a job). Manny recipes run in parallel on idle Mannies; printer recipes wait their turn on the atomic printer.

actions.name: order
actions.description: Give one Manny any documented order (repair, salvage, inspect-sector-object, turn-on-relay, install-bookmark, transfer-to-probe, …) with the body the game documents for it. Dangerous orders need dangerous actions enabled.

action.description: The order's path segment, e.g. salvage.

actions.name: recall
actions.description: Recall a Manny to the probe, cancelling its task.

actions.name: fire
actions.description: Fire a missile at a target in the probe's sector: an embarked Manny prepares it for one minute, then it flies and cannot be recalled.

targetId.description: A contact or object id from the sector reading.

mannyId.description: Default: the first Manny ready aboard.

actions.name: stop-job
actions.description: Stop a running job. Work the game already accepted continues; no further orders are sent. An outpost's job is paused.

actions.name: outpost-pause
actions.description: Pause a mining outpost (no new loads are ordered).

actions.name: bookmark
actions.description: Save a named bookmark on a sector in GUPPI's local archive (shown on the star map).
